"I'd start, but I'm not going on camera" has cost more people more months than any algorithm change.

The camera was never the mechanism. Three faceless formats do the entire job:

1. Screen recording — show the tool doing the thing. The demo is the content.

2. Text on b-roll — one idea, big captions, stock footage underneath.

3. AI voiceover listicle — ranked, fast, and completely scriptable.

Pick ONE. Batch ten at a time on a single day. Keep the frame identical so people recognise you at a glance. Change one variable at a time or you learn nothing from the result.
